from decimal import Decimal, localcontext

from app.domain import *

def test_split_source_amounts_returns_amount_entries_unchanged():
    expense = make_expense(

        SplitKind.AMOUNTS,
        (
            SplitEntry("a", Decimal("1.10")),
            SplitEntry("b", Decimal("11.24")),
        ),
    )

    assert split_source_amounts(expense) == expense.entries


def test_split_source_amounts_calculates_percentage_entries_in_order():
    expense = make_expense(
        "12",
        SplitKind.PERCENTAGES,
        (
            SplitEntry("a", Decimal("25")),
            SplitEntry("b", Decimal("75")),
        ),
    )

    assert split_source_amounts(expense) == (
        SplitEntry("a", Decimal("3")),
        SplitEntry("b", Decimal("9")),
    )


def test_split_source_amounts_calculates_equal_entries_in_order():
    expense = make_expense(
        "10",
        SplitKind.EQUAL,
        (
            SplitEntry("a", Decimal("0")),
            SplitEntry("b", Decimal("0")),
        ),
    )

    assert split_source_amounts(expense) == (
        SplitEntry("a", Decimal("5")),
        SplitEntry("b", Decimal("5")),
    )


def test_split_source_amounts_calculates_share_entries_in_order():
    expense = make_expense(
        "10",
        SplitKind.SHARES,
        (
            SplitEntry("a", Decimal("1")),
            SplitEntry("b", Decimal("3")),
        ),
    )

    assert split_source_amounts(expense) == (
        SplitEntry("a", Decimal("2.5")),
        SplitEntry("b", Decimal("7.5")),
    )


def test_split_source_amounts_uses_decimal_precision_50_for_divisions():
    expense = make_expense(
        "1",
        SplitKind.EQUAL,
        (
            SplitEntry("a", Decimal("0")),
            SplitEntry("b", Decimal("0")),
            SplitEntry("c", Decimal("0")),
        ),
    )

    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 50
        expected_value = Decimal("1") / Decimal("3")

    with localcontext() as context:
        context.prec = 7
        result = split_source_amounts(expense)

    assert result == (
        SplitEntry("a", expected_value),
        SplitEntry("b", expected_value),
        SplitEntry("c", expected_value),
    )

import pytest
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import validate_expense
from stateless import run, supply


def _trip(rates=None):
    return Trip(
        trip_id="trip-1",
        name="Test trip",
        base_currency="USD",
        members=(
            Member("a", "Alice"),
            Member("b", "Bob"),
        ),
        rates=rates if rates is not None else (ExchangeRate("USD", Decimal("1")),),
        actions=(),
        closed=False,
    )


def _expense(
    *,
    expense_id="expense-1",
    payer_id="a",
    amount=Decimal("10"),
    currency="USD",
    split_kind=SplitKind.EQUAL,
    entries=(SplitEntry("a", Decimal("1")), SplitEntry("b", Decimal("1"))),
    description="Dinner",
):
    return Expense(
        expense_id=expense_id,
        payer_id=payer_id,
        amount=amount,
        currency=currency,
        split_kind=split_kind,
        entries=entries,
        description=description,
        occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 1),
    )


def test_validate_expense_accepts_valid_equal_expense():
    expense = _expense()

    assert validate_expense(expense, _trip()) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("expense", "expected"),
    [
        (
            _expense(
                expense_id="",
                payer_id="z",
                amount=Decimal("-1"),
                currency="MISSING",
                entries=(),
            ),
            "invalid expense identity",
        ),
        (
            _expense(
                payer_id="z",
                amount=Decimal("-1"),
                currency="MISSING",
                entries=(),
            ),
            "unknown payer",
        ),
        (
            _expense(amount=Decimal("0"), currency="MISSING", entries=()),
            "invalid amount",
        ),
        (
            _expense(currency="MISSING", entries=()),
            "unknown currency",
        ),
        (
            _expense(entries=()),
            "invalid split members",
        ),
        (
            _expense(entries=(SplitEntry("z", Decimal("0")),)),
            "unknown split member",
        ),
        (
            _expense(entries=(SplitEntry("a", Decimal("0")),)),
            "invalid split value",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_validate_expense_returns_the_first_applicable_error(expense, expected):
    assert validate_expense(expense, _trip()) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "rate",
    [
        Decimal("0"),
        Decimal("-1"),
        Decimal("NaN"),
        Decimal("Infinity"),
        Decimal("-Infinity"),
    ],
)
def test_validate_expense_rejects_missing_or_nonpositive_nonfinite_currency_rates(rate):
    trip = _trip(rates=(ExchangeRate("USD", rate),))

    assert validate_expense(_expense(), trip) == "unknown currency"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "entries",
    [
        (SplitEntry("", Decimal("1")),),
        (SplitEntry("a", Decimal("1")), SplitEntry("a", Decimal("1"))),
    ],
)
def test_validate_expense_rejects_invalid_split_member_ids(entries):
    assert validate_expense(_expense(entries=entries), _trip()) == "invalid split members"


def test_validate_expense_rejects_unknown_split_member():
    expense = _expense(entries=(SplitEntry("z", Decimal("1")),))

    assert validate_expense(expense, _trip()) == "unknown split member"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "value",
    [
        Decimal("0"),
        Decimal("-1"),
        Decimal("NaN"),
        Decimal("Infinity"),
        Decimal("-Infinity"),
    ],
)
def test_validate_expense_rejects_nonpositive_or_nonfinite_split_values(value):
    expense = _expense(entries=(SplitEntry("a", value),))

    assert validate_expense(expense, _trip()) == "invalid split value"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("expense", "expected"),
    [
        (
            _expense(
                entries=(SplitEntry("a", Decimal("2")),),
            ),
            "equal entries must be 1",
        ),
        (
            _expense(
                split_kind=SplitKind.AMOUNTS,
                entries=(SplitEntry("a", Decimal("3")), SplitEntry("b", Decimal("6"))),
            ),
            "amount split does not total expense",
        ),
        (
            _expense(
                split_kind=SplitKind.PERCENTAGES,
                entries=(SplitEntry("a", Decimal("40")), SplitEntry("b", Decimal("50"))),
            ),
            "percentage split does not total 100",
        ),
        (
            _expense(
                split_kind=SplitKind.SHARES,
                entries=(SplitEntry("a", Decimal("2")), SplitEntry("b", Decimal("3"))),
            ),
            None,
        ),
    ],
)
def test_validate_expense_enforces_split_kind_total_rules(expense, expected):
    assert validate_expense(expense, _trip()) == expected

    payment = Payment(
        payment_id="payment-2",
        from_member_id="b",
        to_member_id="a",
        amount_cents=1,
        note="One cent",
        occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 2),
    )

        payment_id="payment-3",

        to_member_id="recipient",
        amount_cents=9876,
        note="Settlement",
        occurred_on=date(2026, 2, 3),

        to_member_id="bob",
        amount_cents=500,
        note="Taxi",
        occurred_on=date(2026, 3, 4),
    )
    original = payment

    first_result = payment_deltas(payment)
    second_result = payment_deltas(payment)

    assert first_result == {"alice": 500, "bob": -500}

import pytest
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import remove_last_action


def _expense_action(expense_id: str = "expense-1") -> ExpenseAction:
    return ExpenseAction(
        Expense(
            expense_id=expense_id,
            payer_id="member-1",
            amount=Decimal("12.34"),
            currency="USD",
            split_kind=SplitKind.EQUAL,
            entries=(SplitEntry("member-1", Decimal("1")),),
            description="Lunch",
            occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 2),
        )
    )


def _payment_action(payment_id: str = "payment-1") -> PaymentAction:
    return PaymentAction(
        Payment(
            payment_id=payment_id,
            from_member_id="member-1",
            to_member_id="member-2",
            amount_cents=500,
            note="Payback",
            occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 3),
        )
    )


def _trip(actions: tuple[Action, ...], closed: bool = False) -> Trip:
    return Trip(
        trip_id="trip-1",
        name="Weekend",
        base_currency="USD",
        members=(Member("member-1", "Ada"), Member("member-2", "Ben")),
        rates=(ExchangeRate("EUR", Decimal("1.08")),),
        actions=actions,
        closed=closed,
    )


def test_remove_last_action_removes_only_the_final_action_from_history():
    expense = _expense_action()
    payment = _payment_action()
    trip = _trip((expense, payment))

    result = remove_last_action(trip)

    assert result.actions == (expense,)
    assert trip.actions == (expense, payment)


def test_remove_last_action_removes_the_only_action_leaving_empty_history():
    expense = _expense_action()
    trip = _trip((expense,))

    result = remove_last_action(trip)

    assert result.actions == ()
    assert trip.actions == (expense,)


def test_remove_last_action_raises_value_error_for_empty_history():
    trip = _trip(())

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"^empty history$"):
        remove_last_action(trip)


def test_remove_last_action_preserves_every_other_trip_field_including_closed():
    first = _expense_action("expense-1")
    last = _payment_action("payment-1")
    trip = _trip((first, last), closed=True)

    result = remove_last_action(trip)

    assert result is not trip
    assert result.trip_id == trip.trip_id
    assert result.name == trip.name
    assert result.base_currency == trip.base_currency
    assert result.members == trip.members
    assert result.rates == trip.rates
    assert result.closed is True
    assert result.actions == (first,)

from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import expense_deltas

def _trip(*, rates=None):

        trip_id="trip-1",

        members=(
            Member("a", "Alice"),

        ),
        rates=tuple(rates or (ExchangeRate("USD", Decimal("1")),)),

        payer_id=payer_id,
        amount=Decimal(amount),
        currency=currency,
        split_kind=SplitKind.AMOUNTS,
        entries=tuple(
            SplitEntry(member_id, Decimal(value))
            for member_id, value in entries
        ),
        description="Dinner",
        occurred_on=date(2024, 1, 1),
    )


def test_expense_deltas_adds_payment_to_payer_and_subtracts_allocations():
    trip = _trip()
    expense = _expense(
        payer_id="a",
        amount="1.00",
        entries=(("a", "0.50"), ("b", "0.50")),

def test_expense_deltas_keeps_payer_when_final_delta_is_zero():
    trip = _trip()
    expense = _expense(
        payer_id="a",
        amount="1.00",
        entries=(("a", "1.00"),),
    )

    assert expense_deltas(expense, trip) == {"a": 0}


def test_expense_deltas_handles_uneven_cent_allocations():
    trip = _trip()
    expense = _expense(
        payer_id="b",
        amount="1.01",
        entries=(("a", "0.51"), ("b", "0.50")),
    )

    assert expense_deltas(expense, trip) == {"b": 51, "a": -51}


def test_expense_deltas_uses_base_cent_allocations_for_converted_expenses():
    trip = _trip(
        rates=(
            ExchangeRate("USD", Decimal("1")),
            ExchangeRate("EUR", Decimal("1.20")),
        )
    )
    expense = _expense(
        payer_id="a",
        amount="1.00",
        currency="EUR",
        entries=(("a", "0.40"), ("b", "0.60")),
    )

    assert expense_deltas(expense, trip) == {"a": 72, "b": -72}


def test_expense_deltas_does_not_mutate_its_inputs():
    trip = _trip()
    expense = _expense(
        payer_id="a",
        amount="1.00",
        entries=(("a", "0.50"), ("b", "0.50")),
    )
    original_trip = trip
    original_expense = expense

    expense_deltas(expense, trip)

    assert trip == original_trip
    assert expense == original_expense

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import append_action


def make_trip(actions=()):
    return Trip(
        trip_id="trip-1",
        name="Weekend",
        base_currency="USD",

            Member("m1", "Ada"),
            Member("m2", "Ben"),
        ),
        rates=(ExchangeRate("USD", Decimal("1")),),
        actions=actions,
        closed=False,
    )


def make_expense(expense_id="e1"):
    return ExpenseAction(
        Expense(
            expense_id=expense_id,
            payer_id="m1",
            amount=Decimal("12.00"),
            currency="USD",
            split_kind=SplitKind.EQUAL,
            entries=(
                SplitEntry("m1", Decimal("1")),
                SplitEntry("m2", Decimal("1")),
            ),
            description="Dinner",
            occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 1),
        )
    )


def make_payment(payment_id="p1"):
    return PaymentAction(
        Payment(
            payment_id=payment_id,
            from_member_id="m2",
            to_member_id="m1",
            amount_cents=600,
            note="Half of dinner",
            occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 2),
        )
    )


def test_append_action_adds_expense_to_empty_history():
    trip = make_trip()
    action = make_expense()

    result = append_action(trip, action)

    assert result.actions == (action,)


def test_append_action_preserves_existing_action_order():
    payment = make_payment()
    expense = make_expense("e2")
    trip = make_trip((payment,))

    result = append_action(trip, expense)

    assert result.actions == (payment, expense)


def test_append_action_returns_replaced_trip_without_changing_original():
    existing_action = make_payment()
    new_action = make_expense()
    trip = make_trip((existing_action,))
    original_actions = trip.actions

    result = append_action(trip, new_action)

    assert result is not trip
    assert trip.actions == original_actions
    assert trip.actions == (existing_action,)
    assert result.trip_id == trip.trip_id
    assert result.name == trip.name
    assert result.base_currency == trip.base_currency
    assert result.members == trip.members
    assert result.rates == trip.rates
    assert result.closed == trip.closed


def test_append_action_keeps_original_action_objects_unchanged_and_in_order():
    existing_action = make_payment()
    action = make_expense()
    trip = make_trip((existing_action,))
    original_expense = action.expense

    result = append_action(trip, action)

    assert result.actions[0] is existing_action
    assert result.actions[1] is action
    assert action.expense is original_expense
    assert action.expense.description == "Dinner"
    assert action.expense.amount == Decimal("12.00")

from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from app.domain import *
from app.abilities import *
from app.fakes import *
from app.logic import close_trip
from stateless import run, supply


def make_open_trip(*, rates=None, closed=False):
    return Trip(
        trip_id="trip-1",
        name="Weekend",
        base_currency="USD",
        members=(Member(member_id="m-1", name="Ada"),),
        rates=(
            (ExchangeRate(currency="USD", base_per_unit=Decimal("1")),)
            if rates is None
            else rates
        ),
        actions=(),
        closed=closed,
    )


def test_close_trip_marks_trip_closed_returns_it_and_saves_it():
    trip = make_open_trip()
    repository = InMemoryTripRepository((trip,))

def _line_numbers(line):

        line.owed_cents,

    )

    )

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=r"^unknown member$"):
        member_statement(trip, "missing")


def test_member_statement_records_expense_and_payment_roles_in_action_order():
    expense = Expense(
        expense_id="expense-1",
        payer_id="a",
        amount=Decimal("100.00"),
        currency="USD",
        split_kind=SplitKind.EQUAL,
        entries=(
            SplitEntry("a", Decimal("0")),
            SplitEntry("b", Decimal("0")),
        ),
        description="Dinner",
        occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 1),
    )
    unrelated_expense = Expense(
        expense_id="expense-2",
        payer_id="c",
        amount=Decimal("20.00"),
        currency="USD",
        split_kind=SplitKind.EQUAL,
        entries=(

            SplitEntry("d", Decimal("0")),
        ),

    )
    payment = Payment(

        note="Settlement",
        occurred_on=date(2026, 1, 3),
    )
    trip = Trip(
        trip_id="trip-1",
        name="Trip",
        base_currency="USD",
        members=(
            Member("a", "Alice"),
            Member("b", "Bob"),
            Member("c", "Cara"),
            Member("d", "Dan"),
        ),
        rates=(ExchangeRate("USD", Decimal("1")),),
        actions=(
            ExpenseAction(expense),
            ExpenseAction(unrelated_expense),
            PaymentAction(payment),
        ),
        closed=False,
    )

    assert [line.action_id for line in alice.lines] == ["expense-1", "payment-1"]

    ]

        alice.paid_cents,
        alice.owed_cents,
        alice.sent_cents,
        alice.received_cents,
        alice.balance_cents,

    assert [_line_numbers(line) for line in bob.lines] == [
        (0, 5000, 0, 0),
        (0, 0, 3000, 0),
    ]
    assert (
        bob.paid_cents,
        bob.owed_cents,
        bob.sent_cents,
        bob.received_cents,
        bob.balance_cents,
    ) == (0, 5000, 3000, 0, -2000)

    assert bob.balance_cents == -250


def test_member_statement_keeps_zero_value_line_for_a_participant_and_omits_unrelated_actions():

    assert alice_statement.owed_cents == 51
    assert alice_statement.balance_cents == 50
    assert bob_statement.owed_cents == 50
    assert bob_statement.balance_cents == -50

def test_invalid_expense_edits_raise_validation_errors_without_saving_changes():
    repository = InMemoryTripRepository((make_trip(),))

    seed = equal_expense("existing", "10")
    saved = execute(record_expense("trip-1", seed), repository)
    assert repository.load_trip("trip-1") == saved

    invalid_amount_split = Expense(
        expense_id="bad-amount",
        payer_id="alice",
        amount=Decimal("10"),
        currency="USD",
        split_kind=SplitKind.AMOUNTS,
        entries=(
            SplitEntry("alice", Decimal("3")),
            SplitEntry("bob", Decimal("6")),
        ),
        description="Bad amount split",
        occurred_on=TODAY,
    )
    invalid_percentage_split = Expense(
        expense_id="bad-percent",
        payer_id="alice",
        amount=Decimal("10"),
        currency="USD",
        split_kind=SplitKind.PERCENTAGES,
        entries=(
            SplitEntry("alice", Decimal("50")),
            SplitEntry("bob", Decimal("49")),
        ),
        description="Bad percentage split",
        occurred_on=TODAY,
    )
    unknown_split_member = Expense(
        expense_id="bad-member",
        payer_id="alice",
        amount=Decimal("10"),
        currency="USD",
        split_kind=SplitKind.EQUAL,
        entries=(
            SplitEntry("alice", Decimal("1")),
            SplitEntry("carol", Decimal("1")),
        ),
        description="Unknown participant",
        occurred_on=TODAY,
    )
    missing_currency_rate = equal_expense("bad-currency", "10", currency="GBP")
    duplicate_action_id = equal_expense("existing", "10")

    cases = (
        (invalid_amount_split, "amount split does not total expense"),
        (invalid_percentage_split, "percentage split does not total 100"),
        (unknown_split_member, "unknown split member"),
        (missing_currency_rate, "unknown currency"),
        (duplicate_action_id, "duplicate action id"),
    )

    for invalid_expense, message in cases:
        with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match=f"^{message}$"):
            execute(record_expense("trip-1", invalid_expense), repository)
        assert repository.load_trip("trip-1") == saved
        assert repository.load_trip("trip-1").actions == (ExpenseAction(seed),)


def test_settle_up_uses_zero_sum_groups_for_minimum_deterministic_transfers():
    balances = {

def test_undo_then_close_preserves_ledger_and_rejects_future_edits():
    repository = InMemoryTripRepository((make_trip(),))
    expense = equal_expense("expense-1", "10")
    payment = Payment(
        payment_id="payment-1",
        from_member_id="bob",
        to_member_id="alice",
        amount_cents=500,
        note="Settle dinner",
        occurred_on=TODAY,
    )

    after_expense = execute(record_expense("trip-1", expense), repository)
    after_payment = execute(record_payment("trip-1", payment), repository)
    assert after_payment.actions == (ExpenseAction(expense), PaymentAction(payment))

    after_undo = execute(undo_last_action("trip-1"), repository)
    assert after_undo.actions == (ExpenseAction(expense),)
    assert repository.load_trip("trip-1") == after_undo

    closed_trip = execute(close_trip("trip-1"), repository)
    assert closed_trip.closed is True
    assert closed_trip.actions == (ExpenseAction(expense),)
    assert repository.load_trip("trip-1") == closed_trip

    with pytest.raises(ClosedTripError, match="trip-1"):
        execute(record_expense("trip-1", equal_expense("expense-2", "8")), repository)

    with pytest.raises(ClosedTripError, match="trip-1"):
        execute(
            record_payment(
                "trip-1",
                Payment(
                    payment_id="payment-2",
                    from_member_id="bob",
                    to_member_id="alice",
                    amount_cents=100,
                    note="Late payment",
                    occurred_on=TODAY,
                ),
            ),
            repository,
        )

    with pytest.raises(ClosedTripError, match="trip-1"):
        execute(undo_last_action("trip-1"), repository)

    assert repository.load_trip("trip-1") == closed_trip
    assert repository.load_trip("trip-1").actions == (ExpenseAction(expense),)
